strings.此文件夹中没有可打开的文件。: No files that can be opened here.
strings.尚未授予“所有文件访问权限”，目前只能使用青页自己的文件夹；其他位置的文件请用“: “All files access” has not been granted, so only Qingye's own folder is available; use “Import from another app” for files elsewhere.
strings.打开手机上的文件前，需要授予“所有文件访问权限”。: Grant “All files access” before opening files on this device.
strings.请先保存文档，再分享。: Save the document before sharing it.
strings.分享的是已保存到文件的版本。: The version saved to the file is shared.
strings.安卓版已在系统的“打开方式”中登记 PDF 与 Markdown，无需在此注册。: On Android, Qingye is already listed under “Open with” for PDF and Markdown; nothing needs to be registered here.
strings.文件不存在或已被移动。: The file does not exist or has been moved.
strings.安卓版不支持多窗口，请使用标签切换文档。: Multiple windows are not available on Android; switch documents with the tabs.
strings.安卓版不提供本地 AI 接口。: The local AI interface is not available on Android.
strings.允许青页访问手机上的文件: Let Qingye access files on this device
strings.青页直接在原位置打开和保存你的 PDF 与 Markdown，需要系统的“所有文:
Qingye opens and saves your PDF and Markdown files where they are, which needs the system's “All files access” permission. Files are processed on this device only and are never uploaded.

You can also continue without it: files opened through “Import from another app” are copied into Qingye's own folder.
strings.轻点页面可以重新显示工具栏: Tap the page to show the toolbars again
strings.安卓版不提供联网补全，请直接填写引用信息。: The Android version has no online lookup. Fill in the reference details directly.
strings.文件超过 120 MB，未加入全库搜索。: The file is larger than 120 MB and was left out of library search.
strings.轻点页面：隐藏或显示上下的工具栏，让页面占满屏幕。\n双击页面：放大到两倍；再双:
Tap the page: hide or show the bars above and below it, so the page fills the screen.
Double-tap the page: zoom to 2×; double-tap again to fit the width. Pinch with two fingers for any zoom.
Long-press text: once it is selected, "Copy / Highlight / Search / Excerpt into the note" appears at the bottom.
Long-press an empty part of the page: the page menu (annotations, page editing, bookmarks, reference details).
Long-press a tab: put that document on the other side of notes mode.
Back: closes menus, leaves notes mode, then returns to the home screen.

Notes mode: enter it from "More". In portrait the PDF is above the note; in landscape and on tablets they are side by side. Drag the divider to resize. Once inside, "Notes mode commands" under "More" selects a region (formulas, figures), syncs annotations and switches scroll sync.

"More" also has library search, sharing, document conversion and settings. All documents are processed on the phone; nothing is uploaded.
